
  // (type type)
  public class Type_type {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic!
    var p_path : String
    var p_pkgname : String
    var p_name : String
    var p_alias : String
    var p_idx : Int
    var p_extends : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_empty : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_propertylist : Vx_Core.Type_varlist!
    var p_container : Vx_Core.Type_type!
    var p_allowtypes : Vx_Core.Type_typelist!
    var p_func : Vx_Core.Type_func!
    var p_isnative : Bool
    var p_prefix : String
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_type_constructor
  public static func v_type_constructor(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    Vx_Core.v_global_reserve()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.Type_type()
    return output
  }

  // v_type_create
  public static func v_type_create(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_constructor()
    Vx_Core.v_type_initialize(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_type_initialize
  public static func v_type_initialize(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_type,
      value)
    value.type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    value.p_path = ""
    value.p_pkgname = ""
    value.p_name = ""
    value.p_alias = ""
    value.p_idx = 0
    value.p_extends = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_empty = Vx_Core.e_any
    value.p_propertylist = Vx_Core.e_varlist
    value.p_container = Vx_Core.e_type
    value.p_allowtypes = Vx_Core.e_typelist
    value.p_func = Vx_Core.e_func
    value.p_isnative = false
    value.p_prefix = ""
  }

  // v_type_shutdown
  public static func v_type_shutdown(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) {
    if value.type_generic !== Vx_Core.e_generic {
      Vx_Core.v_generic_shutdown(
        value.type_generic)
      value.type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    }
    value.p_path = ""
    value.p_pkgname = ""
    value.p_name = ""
    value.p_alias = ""
    value.p_idx = 0
    if value.p_extends !== Vx_Core.e_string {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        Vx_Core.v_cast_string(
          value.p_extends))
      value.p_extends = Vx_Core.e_string
    }
    if value.p_empty !== Vx_Core.e_any {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_empty)
      value.p_empty = Vx_Core.e_any
    }
    if value.p_propertylist !== Vx_Core.e_varlist {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        Vx_Core.v_cast_varlist(
          value.p_propertylist))
      value.p_propertylist = Vx_Core.e_varlist
    }
    value.p_container = Vx_Core.e_type
    if value.p_allowtypes !== Vx_Core.e_typelist {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        Vx_Core.v_cast_typelist(
          value.p_allowtypes))
      value.p_allowtypes = Vx_Core.e_typelist
    }
    if value.p_func !== Vx_Core.e_func {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        Vx_Core.v_cast_func(
          value.p_func))
      value.p_func = Vx_Core.e_func
    }
    value.p_isnative = false
    value.p_prefix = ""
    Vx_Core.v_any_shutdown(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_global_release()
  }

  // v_type_startup
  public static func v_type_startup(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_type
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    Vx_Core.v_type_initialize(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "type",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertylist = Vx_Core.v_varlist_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
          "type-generic",
          Vx_Core.t_generic),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "path",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "pkgname",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "name",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "alias",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "idx",
          Vx_Core.t_intn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "extends",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "empty",
          Vx_Core.t_any),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "propertylist",
          Vx_Core.t_varlist),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "container",
          Vx_Core.t_type),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "allowtypes",
          Vx_Core.t_typelist),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "func",
          Vx_Core.t_func),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "isnative",
          Vx_Core.t_booleann),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "prefix",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_create()
    type_generic.p_code_funcn = Vx_Core.v_code_type
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.v_copy_type
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.v_new_type
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_type
  public static func v_cast_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_type_cast
  public static func v_type_cast(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    if type_any.type_type === Vx_Core.t_type {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_type.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // v_type_copy
  public static func v_type_copy(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_type
  public static func v_copy_type(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_cast(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_copy(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_empty
  public static func v_empty(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = type_type.p_empty
    return output
  }

  // v_type_new
  public static func v_type_new(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_copy(
      Vx_Core.e_type,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // v_new_type
  public static func v_new_type(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_new(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // f_type
  public static func f_type(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_new(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_constructor()
  public static let e_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_constructor()

  // v_typename_from_any
  public static func v_typename_from_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_typename_from_type(
      type_type)
    return output
  }

  // v_typename_from_type
  public static func v_typename_from_type(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    return type_type.p_name
  }

  // v_typenamen_from_any
  public static func v_typenamen_from_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> String {
    let type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : String = Vx_Core.v_typenamen_from_type(
      type_type)
    return output
  }

  // v_typenamen_from_type
  public static func v_typenamen_from_type(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> String {
    let type_string : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_typename_from_type(
      type_type)
    let output : String = Vx_Core.v_stringn_from_string(
      type_string)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_constructor()
  public static let e_type : Type_type = v_type_constructor()
